title: Decision Matrix: Delay Goodwill Share by Overrun and Dealer Sublet (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Decision rule.** The delay goodwill credit on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental is the goodwill share of the value of the credited delay days. The goodwill share depends on the overrun and the delay's cause: where the repair overran its target by more than 3 business days and the calibration order was sublet to a dealer, it is 1.0 (the whole value); where exactly one of those two holds, it is 0.75; otherwise it is 0.5.

The overrun is the business days (Monday to Friday) after the repair start date, up to and including the ready date, less the target turnaround in business days of the repair's service tier, never below zero, all read from the repair order under Customer-Pay Repairs the rental is tied to. The sublet is that of the repair's calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations.

## Matrix

| Overrun of more than 3 business days | Calibration order sublet to a dealer | Goodwill share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1.0 |
| Yes | No | 0.75 |
| No | Yes | 0.75 |
| No | No | 0.5 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Repair started on a Monday and ready on the Friday of the next week, 9 business days, against a target of 5: an overrun of 4, more than 3. With a dealer sublet the share is 1.0; without one, 0.75.
- The same repair against a target of 6: an overrun of 3, not more than 3. With a sublet the share is 0.75; without one, 0.5.
- Hypothetical value: credited days worth 70.00 USD in all give 70.00 USD at a share of 1.0, 52.50 USD at 0.75 and 35.00 USD at 0.5.
